+### What changed, by item
+
+1. Cold start (R651-1-F1, R650-1-F1). thisClock is now ROM data: the generator writes its high
+   and low 32 bits at the two fixed words 1022 and 1023. The engine reads them from the same
+   `UCODE_HEX_P` image at configuration (a never-written copy, read at two constant indexes),
+   so reset itself loads the self tuple into the publication bank: GM thisClock, count 1, zero
+   tail. Parent identity and flags keep their reset values. The engine commits that state once,
+   on the first clock edge after release (no handler can run that early, so the round-1 idle
+   and cancel guards are gone). The init leg installs S_CID from publish word 15, which serves
+   the same value, so the ROM holds thisClock once. No port, parameter or width changed
+   (declarations without comments: sha256 ccf818c7... at pin e4869fd0, base, round 1 and head).
+   STOP check: not met. What the parent does see: the ROM digest changes (a new ledger row) and
+   the boot publication is thisClock instead of zero.
+2. Capability loss (R651-1-F2). 802.1AS-2020 10.3.12 DISABLED: a port that is not asCapable
+   stops contributing its vector at once. Every flags write that clears bit 2 now expires the
+   Announce receipt watch (timer slot 2) in RTL, whichever handler cleared it. BECGATE then:
+   a master keeps no watch; a capable port becomes master as before; an incapable port with an
+   elected peer (present, not master) drops it, writes flags 0 and runs SELF (thisClock as GM
+   and parent, best record to our vector, path {thisClock}, one COMMIT) with no PHC write, so
+   the #75 slew contract ("asCapable loss holds level and rate") is untouched. BECOME now ends
+   in SELF too, and BTCA's own-vector win branches to BECGATE (same semantics, six words less).
+   Announce silence with Pdelay answering still ages the peer out at the 3 s receipt timeout.
+3. Warm reset (R651-1-F3, R650-1-F2). The best record (scratch 2, 3, 20) gets reset-backed
+   validity, the established claim/pairing idiom: until its first write since reset each cell
+   reads all ones, the worst vector, which any received Announce displaces before BTCA weighs
+   our own vector against it. The scratch read address stays the write address (single-port
+   LUTRAM kept). Reset also clears the raw selected path. The init leg no longer seeds the
+   record. The phase-35 comment R651 flagged is rewritten.
+4. R650-1-F3: exactly one engine commit per reset is graded at cold and warm reset, and the
+   warm-reset self tuple after a three-entry peer is graded for count 1 and a zero tail.
+5. Parent mutation gates: committed locally (never pushed) in a scratch parent; both mutant arms
+   ran to completion. See the parent table.

+#!/bin/sh
+# Build the head engine harness against another revision's RTL and generator
+# and run it once with the suite's shipping image arguments.
+# Usage: control_run.sh <rev> <workdir> <log>
+set -e
+REV=$1; W=$2; LOG=$3
+L=<data>/lanes/gptp82-boot
+rm -rf "$W"; mkdir -p "$W/src"
+git -C "$L" archive "$REV" hdl | tar -x -C "$W/src"
+cd "$W"
+python3 src/hdl/ucode/gen_gptp_ucode.py --clk-hz 2000000 --cease-ms 3000 -o gptp_ucode.hex > gen.log
+verilator --cc --exe --build -j 8 --top-module KL_gptp_engine -Wall -Wno-fatal \
+  -Wno-DECLFILENAME -Wno-UNUSEDSIGNAL -Wno-WIDTHEXPAND -Wno-WIDTHTRUNC -Wno-UNUSEDPARAM \
+  -GUCODE_HEX_P='"gptp_ucode.hex"' -GCLK_HZ_P=2000000 \
+  -CFLAGS "-std=c++17 -O2 -I$L/tb/verilator/engine" \
+  src/hdl/ucpu/gptp_ucpu_pkg.sv src/hdl/ucpu/KL_gptp_ucpu.sv src/hdl/wire/KL_gptp_rx_parser.sv \
+  src/hdl/wire/KL_gptp_tx_slot.sv src/hdl/common/KL_gptp_timer.sv src/hdl/top/KL_gptp_engine.sv \
+  "$L/tb/verilator/engine/sim_main.cpp" -o Vctl > build.log 2>&1
+set +e
+./obj_dir/Vctl > "$LOG" 2>&1
+echo "rc=$?" >> "$LOG"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Write RECEIPTS.md: every file under the output directory except the index
+itself, with its size and sha256, plus the large receipts kept in scratch.
+Usage: make_index.py <outdir>"""
+import hashlib, sys
+from pathlib import Path
+root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+GROUPS = [
+    ("HANDOFF.md", "the handoff, rounds 1 and 2"),
+    ("PR-BODY.md", "the PR body draft"),
+    ("receipts/gates/base/", "repository gates at base b9ade3a6 (HEAD names the commit)"),
+    ("receipts/gates/head/", "repository gates at head 8f3c376d (HEAD names the commit)"),
+    ("receipts/pgates/base/", "parent consumer gates, dev e9cbb676 as is (GITLINK e4869fd0)"),
+    ("receipts/pgates/head/", "parent consumer gates at local commits e54c7c21 (gitlink) and 3d0cae2b (tests)"),
+    ("receipts/parent/", "the two local parent commits: stats, the docs, ledger and test diffs"),
+    ("receipts/controls/", "head harness against the base and round-1 RTL and ROM"),
+    ("receipts/r651/head/", "R651-1 cold, gone and warm probes re-run at head"),
+    ("receipts/r651/round1/", "the same probes at the round-1 head 85373de0"),
+    ("receipts/iface/", "parameter and port declarations, comments stripped, at four revisions"),
+    ("receipts/rom/", "ROM packing for the three images at head and base"),
+    ("receipts/synth/", "synthesis-proxy statistics of the engine at base and head"),
+    ("receipts/scripts/", "the scratch scripts these receipts were produced with"),
+]
+SCRATCH = [
+    ("<data>/tmp/gptp82-a649/r2/synth/base/synth.log", 750086, "372e75c5133a18a2f458524a922c8fcf79d6cfa8da0eb63a5af8f4767fc3a6a1"),
+    ("<data>/tmp/gptp82-a649/r2/synth/head-final/synth.log", 744897, "e4350b25f2af02a58bd57ed300df3b3bc63ffc623e3bc02546f8043a2e07e25c"),
+    ("<data>/tmp/gptp82-a649/r2/synth/varb/synth.log", 744567, "fd64e5dded731fe622838f0e721f1d4dce3de0d9726cfc737092f9e99c121104"),
+]
+files = sorted(p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name != "RECEIPTS.md")
+rows = []
+for p in files:
+    rel = p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+    data = p.read_bytes()
+    assert len(data) < 200 * 1024, rel
+    desc = next(d for g, d in GROUPS if rel == g or rel.startswith(g))
+    rows.append((rel, len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), desc))
+out = ["# Round 2 receipts index", "",
+       "Every file under this directory except this index, with its size in bytes and sha256.",
+       "`receipts/scripts/verify_receipts.py <this directory>` checks that the table and the",
+       "directory match exactly.", "",
+       "| file | bytes | sha256 | what it is |", "|---|---:|---|---|"]
+out += [f"| `{r}` | {n} | `{h}` | {d} |" for r, n, h, d in rows]
+out += ["", "## Kept in scratch (over 200 KB), by size and sha256", "",
+        "| scratch file | bytes | sha256 | what it is |", "|---|---:|---|---|"]
+out += [f"| `{r}` | {n} | `{h}` | full synthesis log behind `receipts/synth/` |" for r, n, h in SCRATCH]
+(root / "RECEIPTS.md").write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n")
+print(f"indexed {len(rows)} files")

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Print fixed-program sizes, leg sizes and free words of one generator."""
+import importlib.util, sys
+gen = sys.argv[1]
+args = sys.argv[2:]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("g", gen)
+g = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(g)
+seq = int(args[0], 0) if args else 0
+sseq = int(args[1], 0) if len(args) > 1 else 0
+g.RUNTIME["cease_ms"] = 3000
+g.set_servo_gains(2_000_000)
+rom, used = g.build(0x02A1B2C3D4E5, seq, sseq)
+fixed = [(16, g.prog_rx_sync), (64, g.prog_rx_followup), (128, g.prog_rx_announce),
+         (192, g.prog_rx_pdreq), (256, g.prog_rx_pdresp), (320, g.prog_rx_pdrfu),
+         (384, g.prog_rx_signal), (448, g.prog_tx_ts),
+         (512, lambda b: g.prog_tmr(b, 0x02A1B2C3D4E5, seq, sseq)), (704, g.prog_tb_battery)]
+occ = [None]*1024
+for b, fn in fixed:
+    n = len(fn(b).words()); print(f"fixed {b:4d}: {n:3d}")
+    for i in range(n): occ[b+i] = f"F{b}"
+for name, fn in g.LEG_FNS:
+    n = len(fn(g.LB[name]).words()); print(f"leg {name:8s} @{g.LB[name]:4d}: {n:3d}")
+    for i in range(n): occ[g.LB[name]+i] = name
+for a in (g.ROM_CID_HI_C, g.ROM_CID_LO_C): occ[a] = "CID"
+free = [i for i in range(1024) if occ[i] is None]
+print("used", used, "free", len(free), free)

+"""Run a suite's own mutation arm main(), control included, over the
+mutants named on the command line. Usage: run_by_names.py <suite> <name>..."""
+import sys, importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+suite, names = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), sys.argv[2:]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mutants", suite / "mutants.py")
+m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(m)
+m.MUTATIONS = [x for x in m.MUTATIONS if x[0] in names]
+assert len(m.MUTATIONS) == len(names), [x[0] for x in m.MUTATIONS]
+print(f"{len(m.MUTATIONS)} named mutants: " + "; ".join(x[0] for x in m.MUTATIONS), flush=True)
+sys.exit(m.main())

+included, over MUTATIONS[k::n]. Usage: shard_mutants.py <suite_dir> <k> <n>"""
+import sys, importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+suite, k, n = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mutants", suite / "mutants.py")
+m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(m)
+full = list(m.MUTATIONS)
+m.MUTATIONS = full[k::n]
+print(f"shard {k}/{n}: {len(m.MUTATIONS)} of {len(full)} mutants: "
+      + "; ".join(x[0] for x in m.MUTATIONS), flush=True)
+sys.exit(m.main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Check RECEIPTS.md against the directory: the same set of files, each with
+the recorded size and sha256. Usage: verify_receipts.py <outdir>"""
+import hashlib, re, sys
+from pathlib import Path
+root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
+rows = {}
+for line in (root / "RECEIPTS.md").read_text().splitlines():
+    m = re.match(r"^\| `([^`]+)` \| (\d+) \| `([0-9a-f]{64})` \|", line)
+    if m and not m.group(1).startswith("/"):
+        rows[m.group(1)] = (int(m.group(2)), m.group(3))
+files = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): p for p in root.rglob("*")
+         if p.is_file() and p.name != "RECEIPTS.md"}
+bad = sorted(set(rows) ^ set(files))
+for rel in sorted(set(rows) & set(files)):
+    data = files[rel].read_bytes()
+    if (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) != rows[rel]:
+        bad.append(rel)
+print(f"{len(files)} files, {len(rows)} index rows, {len(bad)} mismatches")
+for b in bad:
+    print("MISMATCH", b)
+sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
